caption: The drawing depicts a gray pig walking on the blade of a large knife, which is placed horizontally near the bottom of the composition. The knife has a metallic gray blade and a reddish-brown handle. The pig is connected by a string or leash to a man standing to the right of the pig. The man, also rendered in shades of gray, is wearing a jacket, pants, and a hat, and has a beard. He is holding the leash in one hand and raising a stick or rod in the other. The man stands with one foot on the metal part of the knife and the other on the wooden handle. The background is a solid off-white or cream color, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Butcher's Shop Sign
